title: The Tidal Dark
text: The dark comes in like a tide, rolling and black, swallowing the land, and goes out again. Each time it goes out, something is left on the shore: a shoe, a sword, a face, a child's toy. The tide is coming in again.

options.label: Comb the shore between tides, and gather what the dark leaves behind.

outcomes.text: The tide comes in early, and for a while you are under it.

options.label: The quickest runs the shore at low tide, and races the dark back.

outcomes.text: Back with an armful before the dark returns.

options.label: Keep to high ground, and watch what the tide does.

outcomes.text: You watch the tide take something that was walking toward you, and learn the shape of what lies ahead.
